title: DomainProvision - Tooling API
description: Represents provisioned changes to custom domains. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.

CnameTarget.description: Represents the canonical name (CNAME) of the external host or server for this domain. If you use a non-Salesforce provider, such as your own external server or CDN provider, to serve your domain, this field points to the CNAME of the external provider.

IsActive.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsActive.description: Represents whether the provisioning for this domain is processing or complete (true) or not (false). When you activate a provisioned domain, this field is set to false. The default value is false.

ProvisionEndDate.description: Represents when the provisioning process was finished.

ProvisionFinalizeDate.description: Represents when the provisioning process was canceled or when the provisioned domain was activated.

ProvisionStartDate.description: Represents when the provisioning process started.

TargetCdnCertificate.description: If the domain is served on the Salesforce Content Delivery Network (CDN), represents the certificate that serves this domain. If your domain uses another domain configuration option, this field is null.

TargetDomainName.description: Represents the domain name, such as www.example.com.

special_access_rules: Only users with the Salesforce Integration user permission can access this object.
